_meanings:
²1 To free, liberate.
.²2 To loosen, unbind, unfasten, untie; {#tato vimuktvA saSaraM SarAsanam#}
 <ls>Rām. 6. 111. 124</ls>; {#AsIdvivfttavadanA ca vimocayantI#} ({#valkalam#}) <ls>Ś. 2. 13</ls>.
.²3 To give up, lay aside, abandon, quit; {#vimucya rozaM ripunigrahAttataH#}
 <ls>Rām. 6. 111. 124</ls>; {#vimucya vAsAMsi gurURi sAMpratam#} <ls>Ṛs. 1. 7</ls>.
.²4 To let go, let loose; <ls>Bk. 7. 50</ls>.
.²5 To except, set aside, set apart; {#nanu mAM kAmavaDe vimuYcatA#} <ls>Ku. 4. 31</ls>.
.²6 To shed, pour down (tears); {#ciramaSrURi vimucya rAGavaH#} <ls>R. 8. 25</ls>.
.²7 To throw, cast.
.²8 To take off (clothes), undress oneself.
.²9 To stop, cease.
.²10 To take, assume; {#samAviSati saMsfzwastadA mUrti vimuYcati#} <ls>Ms. 1. 56</ls>.
.²11 To utter (a sound).
.²12 To lay (eggs). --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%}
.²1 To be deprived of, be freed from.
.²2 To drop, be expelled (as a foetus).
